messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — planning to roll quant-v3-hotpatch (kernel + matmul tweak) to staging at 00:30 UTC tonight. Deploybot will pin traffic for staging->canary. Can people confirm rollback criteria and pin TTL?
Sam: SGTM. From perf side: if P99 latency increases > 20ms for > 5m in the canary slice, we should auto-rollback. Also watch eviction-rate on KV cache — last patch saw a small spike.
Leo: Noted. Adding a micro-oom detector as well — last time a tiny subset of nvidia-rtx nodes hit OOM under a rare batch shape. If OOM count > 3 in 10m in canary region, rollback.
Irene: Ops request: pin TTL should be short by default — 2h — so we don't hold if something weird. We can extend to 6h manually if metrics are green.
Rachel: Release notes draft: "quant-v3-hotpatch: optimized matmul kernel, reduced memory for prefix-KV, known issue: rare OOM on older drivers (see mitigation below)." Link to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4521
Maya: Agree on thresholds. Summarize automatic rollback triggers: 1) P99 +20ms for >5m, 2) eviction-rate > 1% sustained 10m, 3) OOM events >=3 within 10m. Manual abort if error-rate on token-generation > 0.5%.
deploybot: [info] deploy queued: quant-v3-hotpatch -> staging at 00:30 UTC. Pin TTL=7200s. Canary slice=5%. Healthprobes: p99_latency, kv_eviction_rate, oom_count, gen_error_rate.
Sam: Can we add a brief smoke that runs a few heavy-batch prompts (seq_len 2048, batch 8) to staging after deploy? If that fails, rollback immediately.
Irene: Yes — ops-bot will run smoke after deploy. ops-bot:run_smoke --profile heavy-batch --target staging
ops-bot: [started] heavy-batch smoke at 00:34 UTC (estimated 2m)
Leo: Also add a telemetry tag so we can isolate drivers with older CUDA. telemetry: kernel=matmul_v3-hotpatch, driver_tag=canary-2026-03-21
Rachel: I'll update release notes with the rollback criteria and add the mitigation steps (temporary pin to quant-v2 on rollback, contact infra).
Maya: Last item — who'll own the post-deploy watch handoff at 01:00 UTC?
Sam: I can own 00:30–01:00. Leo takes 01:00–02:00 if anything lingers.
Maya: Great. If ops-bot smoke passes and metrics stay green for 15m, increase canary to 20% and extend TTL to 6h.
Irene: A few ops checklist items: ensure autoscaler not triggered by the smoke, and confirm KV cache warmup within 3 minutes.
deploybot: [info] canary bump plan prepared: 5% -> 20% after 15m health OK. Rollback actions pre-baked.
Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll post the release notes + rollout plan in #eng-runtime and ping infra if any driver issues pop up. :thumbsup:
Sam: one more — if we see increased token_drop (>=0.2%), do immediate rollback and mark as regression for the QA run.
Maya: noted and added. End of thread.
